key_insight: IntElicit turns creativity assessment into a constrained multi-turn dialogue that reduces knowledge and motivation confounds while preserving the participant’s own creative contribution.
engineering_relevance: The framework is relevant for building AI-mediated assessment and tutoring systems that can elicit higher-quality human reasoning without directly supplying answers.
method: Uses a constrained adaptive AI interviewer with non-directive knowledge and agency scaffolds.
Optimizes dialogue policy to elicit reasoning rather than dictate solutions.
Adds decomposed process rewards to reduce sparse-reward issues and reward hacking.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports participant simulation plus a human subject study with N=64, showing improved elicited creative outcomes over expert-designed baselines.
watch_item: Because the system relies on reward design in open-ended dialogue, it may still be sensitive to reward misspecification or unintended prompting behavior.
paper_title: IntElicit: Eliciting and Assessing Contextualized Creativity via Dialogue Policy Optimization
